name: cc-usage-plugin
description: Claude Code usage ledger from hooks: per-session repository, model, skill, command and token metadata plus commit, PR and edit counts, never prompt content; optional batched upload to an HTTPS receiver. Windows/macOS/Linux, Node >= 22.23.4, zero dependencies

developer.title: Developer
developer.description: Your own handle, unique per person (e.g. alex). Stamped on every record and used as your folder name on the receiver: lowercase letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-' are kept, anything else becomes '-'. Leave empty to use the OS login name.

team.title: Team
team.description: Team label attached to every record (e.g. platform)

endpoint.title: Receiver URL (optional)
endpoint.description: HTTPS endpoint that accepts POST of NDJSON batches and answers 202. Leave empty to keep a local ledger only.

token.title: Receiver token (optional)
token.description: Shared token, sent as the X-Webhook-Token header

flush_hours.title: Upload interval (hours)
flush_hours.description: Upload at most once per this many hours (default 24), earlier when 64 KB are waiting.
